propositions: summary_compute resolves ticket state through show_state but omits the resolved alias from its return payload, causing four-character caller-supplied prefixes to be locally salient to agents instead of durable aliases.
The summary JSON schema, library documentation, CLI, and MCP contracts institutionalize an alias-free output shape that agents copy for tracker commands.
Agent guidance lacks an affirmative rule to prefer aliases for tracker commands after discovery while reserving canonical UUIDs for identity-sensitive artifacts like rebar-ticket trailers.

Pinned behavioral evaluation with Haiku 4.5 at temperature 0 produced 25/25 four-character prefix commands with prefix-only summaries, 25/25 alias commands when the resolved alias field was added locally, and 25/25 full canonical UUIDs in rebar-ticket trailers even with alias present.

The repair adds the exact resolved alias as an additive field to every summary result, updates schema and documentation across library/MCP/CLI, adds affirmative agent guidance, and maintains fail-closed behavior for ambiguous prefixes and preservation of canonical IDs for identity-sensitive contracts.
